cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Not Up for Debate
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation from examining where your authority comes from or whether it is legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put me down as shift leader. I'll get tomorrow's cafe stock organized; how much milk do we need?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who appointed you? I usually do the order.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you'll keep doing it. Choose the quantities; I'll make sure your system runs smoothly. Milk first?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order it, but I'm writing appointment unconfirmed beside your name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use your supplies format instead. No names column, just items and quantities. You set it out how you like; I'll coordinate the delivery. Milk won't ask who appointed me.
